title: Activation-aware scaling pipeline, CI calibration cadence, and runtime kernel adapters for INT8
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Build a deployable activation-aware INT8 workflow that produces per-layer activation rescale profiles (SmoothQuant-style), integrates these profiles into model artifacts, validates accuracy via CI/Eval harnesses, and implements lightweight runtime kernel adapters that apply activation scaling with optional fallback to existing FP16/FP32 code paths. Goals: (1) reproducible offline calibration that outputs compact quantization profiles, (2) CI checks that prevent accuracy regressions on representative prompts, (3) runtime kernel adapters that read profiles and apply per-layer activation/weight scaling without large perf regressions, (4) rollout strategy with canary and automatic fallback when accuracy drift is detected. Calibration approach: collect a small representative corpus (OpenWebText-100k subset + internal downstream prompts) and run per-layer activation statistics to compute scaling factors for activation/weight pairs. Emit a profile JSON schema: model_version, layer_order, scale_type(per_channel|per_tensor), scale_values (base64-encoded floats), calibration_stats (mean, std, histogram_buckets), calibration_date, calibration_seed, calibration_dataset_id. Profile will be stored alongside checkpoint in model artifact registry and referenced in the manifest. Runtime changes: add a lightweight adapter layer in the runtime that (a) loads profile at model init, (b) injects a per-layer pre-mul/post-mul to apply activation rescale before matmul and undo after, (c) leverages fused kernels when available to avoid extra memory copies. Kernel work: implement two paths — a fused-kernel path that accepts scale factors and applies scaling inside matmul kernel (preferred for perf), and an adapter path that applies scaling via pointwise ops when fused kernel not available. Kernel selector: extend runtime kernel selector to prefer fused-scaling kernels for layers with profiles; fall back to adapter path; and fall back to FP16 path if INT8 kernels fail. CI/Eval: create an accuracy gate that runs a small eval suite (language model perplexity on WikiText-103 subset, few-shot generation quality on sampled prompts, and embedding cosine on semantic pairs) for every calibration commit and model release. Thresholds: <0.5% perplexity regression, embedding cosine delta <0.02, and no downstream task RMSE increase >1.5x baseline. Instrumentation & observability: record per-request model_variant (INT8-scaled, INT8-adapter, FP16), per-layer scale usage, applied_fallback_reason, token-level latency, and token-cost delta. Metrics flow to Console: dashboard for accuracy vs cost tradeoff, and alerts when regressions exceed thresholds. Migration & rollout: add a model_manifest flag quant_profile_enabled=true. Default rollout: onboard internal models under canary (5%), measure 48h, expand to 25% then 100% if stable. Provide an emergency kill switch to revert to FP16. Backward compatibility: profiles are optional; runtime must still load models without profiles. Compatibility with Dedicated/Private: profile loading should be local-only and not depend on hosted control plane. Testing plan: unit tests for profile parser, kernel unit-tests with random tensors and grads checked via reference FP32, integration e2e in CI with small 100M-1B models, nightly full-eval on 7 representative models. Deliverables: design doc (Confluence link), calibration CLI + docker image, profile JSON schema, runtime adapter and fused-kernel implementations, CI eval harness changes, dashboard widgets, rollout runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration CLI produces valid profile JSON and model artifact contains profile reference
CI accuracy gate runs on PRs touching calibration/runtime and blocks if thresholds exceeded
Fused-kernel implementation shows <5% throughput regression relative to FP16 and >2x cost improvement per token in benchmark infra
Adapter path works end-to-end with correct numerical behaviour within acceptance thresholds
Runtime kernel selector chooses fused-scaling kernels when available and logs fallback reasons
Model manifest flag enables/disables quant_profile usage and rollback works in <5 minutes
Observability captures per-request variant and per-layer scaling metrics in Console dashboards

Filed ENG-24167 and ENG-24168 respectively and marked this ticket blocked on those fixes.

Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/881
